name: Songal’s Elemental Suffusion

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: you gain Resistance to it and a Fly Speed of 30 feet (you can hover). When you cast the spell and at the start of each of your turns, creatures you choose (your foes) in a 15-foot Emanation make a Dexterity save: 2d6 damage of that type and Prone on a failure, half damage only on a success. The Circle casting isn't in the game.
